title: M2 Research Intern - Systems Biology
description: Developed coarse-grained and self-replicating models of bacterial growth and bioproduction, focusing on bacterial production of propanediol. Performed E. coli experiments for model calibration and validation and combined mathematical modelling, computational analysis and microbiological experiments. Collaborated with the Suckjoon Jun Lab at UC San Diego on single-cell versus population E. coli experiments using fluorescent ribosome reporters, resulting in a bioRxiv preprint.

title: Optional Research Intern - Systems Biology
description: Analysed the Mycobacterium tuberculosis exo-metabolome using genome-scale metabolic modelling. Integrated experimental data into a genome-scale model, applied Flux Balance Analysis and sampling approaches, and analysed model outputs to investigate changes in metabolic behaviour and pathways under different conditions.

title: M1 Research Intern - Data Analysis & Machine Learning
description: Analysed clinical and cognitive data from the ADNI database using statistical and machine-learning approaches. Developed a classification framework for identifying patterns associated with Alzheimer’s disease and contributed to research resulting in a peer-reviewed publication.

title: Robotics and Programming Trainer
description:
Taught 12 high school students Python and front-end web development in a robotics and programming bootcamp. 
 Developed course materials, exercises, challenges and assessment criteria.

title: iOS Developer
description:
Developed the Orbit Now video-on-demand and live-TV application using Swift. 
 Collaborated with product, project-management, design and QA teams and contributed to application performance optimization.

title: Full-Stack Developer
description: Developed web applications using Node.js/Express, PHP/Laravel, JavaScript, React and SQL. Worked with Linux/LAMP environments and Agile project-management practices.
